AOC Gaming 27G50Z 27 Inch FHD Fast IPS 260Hz (OC) Gaming Monitor

Dominate the eSports arena with the AOC Gaming 27G50Z 27 Inch gaming monitor, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Tailored specifically for high-level competitive gaming on an expansive display, this monitor utilizes elite Fast IPS technology to deliver an incredibly fluid 260Hz overclocked (OC) refresh rate and an ultra-fast 0.3ms MPRT response time to completely wipe out ghosting and motion blur. Despite its extreme speed, the IPS panel ensures stunning visual quality with rich color depth covering 121.5% sRGB, supported by HDR10 and wide 178-degree viewing angles. It comes packed with Adaptive-Sync technology for tear-free gaming, Shadow Control to illuminate dark areas, and a 3-sided frameless ZeroFrame design perfect for clean multi-monitor setups. This premium eSports display is backed by a 3-year warranty setup.
